content:
Oh great and radiant Nefertiti, 
Blessed Queen of beauty and grace, 
We come before you with hearts full of love and reverence. 
May your divine light shine upon us, 
Guiding us with wisdom and strength.
Grant us the courage to embrace our own beauty and power,
And to walk with confidence and grace in all that we do.
May your divine presence fill our hearts with love and compassion,
And may we be inspired to spread kindness and harmony to all beings.
We offer our prayers and devotion to you, 
Our beloved Nefertiti, 
Queen of Egypt, 
Our eternal guide and patron. 
May your blessings be upon us always. 
Amen.
